topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can't believe this is happening. They took your car right from where you parked it, like it was nothing? What were they thinking? How are you supposed to get to work now, or do anything? This is such a mess. I don't even know where to start. I'm already looking online, trying to figure out what the process is, how to get it back. You shouldn’t have to deal with this, not today, not ever. I’m on my way, and we’ll sort this out together, okay? Just hold tight, I’m coming.
